```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
options(scipen = 999)
```
```{r}
d_gender_scmed <- read_csv('../data/BES-2017-f2f-gender-fb-tw.csv')
```
#Visualisation
```{r}
d_gender_scmed %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x=Gender)
  )+
  geom_bar()
```
```{r}
d_gender_scmed %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x=Use_Facebook)
  )+
  geom_bar()
```
#Hypothesis
Gender is associated with Facebook use
#Findings
```{r}
test_results <- chisq.test(
  x=d_gender_scmed$Gender,
  y=d_gender_scmed$Use_Facebook
)
```
Observed values:
```{r}
test_results$observed
```
Expected results
```{r}
test_results$expected
```
Test
```{r}
test_results
```
